activities_outcome_required.name: activities_outcome_required
activities_outcome_required.value: ("activities"."type" = 'NOTE' and "activities"."outcome" is null) or ("activities"."type" <> 'NOTE' and "activities"."outcome" is not null)

leads_single_discard_state.name: leads_single_discard_state
leads_single_discard_state.value: ("leads"."status" = 'DISCARDED' and "leads"."discard_reason" is not null) or ("leads"."status" <> 'DISCARDED' and "leads"."discard_reason" is null and "leads"."discard_note" is null)

notifications_body_length.name: notifications_body_length
notifications_body_length.value: "notifications"."body" is null or char_length("notifications"."body") between 1 and 200

notifications_link_length.name: notifications_link_length
notifications_link_length.value: "notifications"."link" is null or char_length("notifications"."link") between 1 and 300

plugin_order_payment_tx_voucher_uq.name: plugin_order_payment_tx_voucher_uq
plugin_order_payment_tx_voucher_uq.where: "plugin_order_payment_transactions"."bank_voucher_no" IS NOT NULL AND "plugin_order_payment_transactions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

plugin_order_payment_tx_idempotency_uq.name: plugin_order_payment_tx_idempotency_uq
plugin_order_payment_tx_idempotency_uq.where: "plugin_order_payment_transactions"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "plugin_order_payment_transactions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

sales_insights_status_fields.name: sales_insights_status_fields
sales_insights_status_fields.value: ("sales_insights"."status" = 'DISMISSED' and "sales_insights"."dismiss_reason" is not null and "sales_insights"."accepted_task_id" is null) or ("sales_insights"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' and "sales_insights"."dismiss_reason" is null and "sales_insights"."accepted_task_id" is not null) or ("sales_insights"."status" in ('OPEN', 'EXPIRED') and "sales_insights"."dismiss_reason" is null and "sales_insights"."accepted_task_id" is null)

score_rules_value_by_operator.name: score_rules_value_by_operator
score_rules_value_by_operator.value: ("score_rules"."operator" in ('EXISTS', 'NOT_EXISTS') and "score_rules"."value" is null) or ("score_rules"."operator" not in ('EXISTS', 'NOT_EXISTS') and "score_rules"."value" is not null and char_length(btrim("score_rules"."value")) between 1 and 200)

tasks_completed_timestamp.name: tasks_completed_timestamp
tasks_completed_timestamp.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'DONE' and "tasks"."completed_at" is not null) or ("tasks"."status" <> 'DONE' and "tasks"."completed_at" is null)

win_reviews_review_fields.name: win_reviews_review_fields
win_reviews_review_fields.value:
("win_reviews"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "win_reviews"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null and "win_reviews"."review_reason" is null and "win_reviews"."reviewed_at" is null)
    or ("win_reviews"."status" in ('REVIEWED', 'REJECTED') and "win_reviews"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null
      and "win_reviews"."review_reason" is not null and char_length(btrim("win_reviews"."review_reason")) > 0 and "win_reviews"."reviewed_at" is not null
      and "win_reviews"."generation_failed_at" is null and char_length(btrim("win_reviews"."summary")) > 0 and jsonb_array_length("win_reviews"."evidence") > 0)
